headline: Overtime spending against a $506,356.00 budget, plus Station 3 waterproofing and Headquarters roof projects.
summary: Fire Chief Kadlewicz will report on 3 firefighters injured on duty and on overtime spending. Other business covers recruit hiring, building projects, and turnout gear.
items: Fire Chief's report on injured-on-duty firefighters, light duty, and overtime spending
